messages.content:
Write JSON only: an object mapping each requested kind to a list of TWO distinct short factual government bulletin templates. All amounts are in million crowns. Preserve the exact semantics. Each template must contain EACH named placeholder exactly once, in braces, and no other braces. Do not add facts, dates, numbers, source headings or commentary. Plain English. Make the variants different enough to read naturally. No implicit cash payment for a proposal, authority or contract. Template specifications:
{"announce": ["project amount date", "A proposed funding announcement on date of amount million crowns for project. No approval, contract or cash payment has occurred."], "authorize": ["project amount date", "Effective date, total active spending authority for project becomes amount million crowns. This is a total ceiling, not an increment or a cash payment."], "payment": ["project amount date id", "A settled external cash transfer of amount million crowns for project with payment reference id and settlement date date. Reporting may occur later."], "cumulative": ["project amount date id", "Checkpoint id reports cumulative cash paid for project through date as amount million crowns. Includes all earlier payments; not an additional transfer."], "revise_payment": ["project amount date id", "An accounting correction replaces the earlier amount of payment reference id with amount million crowns for project, settled on date. Not a new transfer or refund."], "revise_cumulative": ["project amount date id", "Corrected checkpoint id replaces its earlier cumulative cash total for project through date with amount million crowns. Not new spending."], "cancel": ["project date", "From date the project is cancelled and active spending authority is zero. Earlier cash payments are retained by recipients, without refund."], "cut": ["project amount date", "From date the total active spending authority for project is reduced to amount million crowns. Earlier payments are not refunded. This is not a cash transfer."], "contract": ["project amount date", "A contract for project worth amount million crowns was signed on date, but it remains entirely unpaid. This does not change the already stated budget authority."], "pending": ["project amount date", "A cash payment for project of amount million crowns is proposed for date but has not settled. Do not describe it as money already paid."], "combined": ["project amount date id other otheramount total", "A joint settlement on date paid total million crowns: amount for project under reference id and otheramount for other. The project amount is only its own share."]}

message.content:
{
  "announce": [
    "A proposed funding announcement on {date} of {amount} million crowns for {project}. No approval, contract or cash payment has occurred.",
    "On {date}, a proposal to allocate {amount} million crowns to {project} was announced. This is not an approval, contract, or cash payment."
  ],
  "authorize": [
    "Effective {date}, total active spending authority for {project} becomes {amount} million crowns. This is a total ceiling, not an increment or a cash payment.",
    "As of {date}, the total active spending authority for {project} is set at {amount} million crowns. This represents a total ceiling, not an increment or cash payment."
  ],
  "payment": [
    "A settled external cash transfer of {amount} million crowns for {project} with payment reference {id} and settlement date {date}. Reporting may occur later.",
    "External cash transfer of {amount} million crowns for {project} settled on {date} under reference {id}. Note that reporting may occur later."
  ],
  "cumulative": [
    "Checkpoint {id} reports cumulative cash paid for {project} through {date} as {amount} million crowns. Includes all earlier payments; not an additional transfer.",
    "Through {date}, checkpoint {id} indicates cumulative cash paid for {project} totals {amount} million crowns. This includes prior payments and is not an additional transfer."
  ],
  "revise_payment": [
    "An accounting correction replaces the earlier amount of payment reference {id} with {amount} million crowns for {project}, settled on {date}. Not a new transfer or refund.",
    "Payment reference {id} for {project} settled on {date} is corrected to {amount} million crowns via accounting adjustment. This is not a new transfer or refund."
  ],
  "revise_cumulative": [
    "Corrected checkpoint {id} replaces its earlier cumulative cash total for {project} through {date} with {amount} million crowns. Not new spending.",
    "Checkpoint {id} is corrected to show cumulative cash for {project} through {date} as {amount} million crowns, replacing the previous total. This is not new spending."
  ],
  "cancel": [
    "From {date} the {project} is cancelled and active spending authority is zero. Earlier cash payments are retained by recipients, without refund.",
    "Active spending authority for {project} is zero from {date} due to cancellation. Recipients retain earlier cash payments without refund."
  ],
  "cut": [
    "From {date} the total active spending authority for {project} is reduced to {amount} million crowns. Earlier payments are not refunded. This is not a cash transfer.",
    "Total active spending authority for {project} is cut to {amount} million crowns effective {date}. No refunds are issued for earlier payments. This is not a cash transfer."
  ],
  "contract": [
    "A contract for {project} worth {amount} million crowns was signed on {date}, but it remains entirely unpaid. This does not change the already stated budget authority.",
    "Contract for {project} valued at {amount} million crowns signed on {date} is currently unpaid. This action does not alter existing budget authority."
  ],
  "pending": [
    "A cash payment for {project} of {amount} million crowns is proposed for {date} but has not settled. Do not describe it as money already paid.",
    "Proposed cash payment of {amount} million crowns for {project} scheduled for {date} remains unsettled. It should not be described as money already paid."
  ],
  "combined": [
    "A joint settlement on {date} paid {total} million crowns: {amount} for {project} under reference {id} and {otheramount} for {other}. The project amount is only its own share.",
    "Joint settlement dated {date} totaling {total} million crowns covers {amount} for {project} (reference {id}) and {otheramount} for {other}. The {project} figure reflects only its specific share."
  ]
}
